# noozle_pulsar_outlet (Data Source)

Reads a Noozle Pulsar outlet by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.

data "noozle_pulsar_outlet" "alerts" {
  id = 123
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (Number) Unique identifier of the outlet.

### Read-Only

- `applied_generation` (Number) Last observed applied config generation.
- `apply_status` (String) Observed apply/runtime status for the outlet.
- `config_generation` (Number) Desired outlet config generation.
- `description` (String) Optional note explaining the outlet purpose.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the outlet is active.
- `key` (String) Pulsar message key interpolation.
- `last_apply_error` (String) Last observed apply/runtime error message.
- `max_in_flight` (Number) Maximum number of in-flight Pulsar messages.
- `name` (String) Name presented for the outlet.
- `notify_policy` (String) Delivery policy applied when notifying this outlet.
- `oauth2` (Block, Read-only) Observed OAuth2 feature state for the Pulsar outlet. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--oauth2))
- `ordering_key` (String) Pulsar ordering key interpolation.
- `tls` (Block, Read-only) Observed TLS feature state for the Pulsar outlet. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--tls))
- `token` (Block, Read-only) Observed token feature state for the Pulsar outlet. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--token))
- `topic` (String) Pulsar topic.
- `transform` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--transform))
- `url` (String) Pulsar broker URL.
